Oh right… I wanted to go to church. I wonder if it’s even open right now.
it’s {f_Integer}.{{wi}} I guess I will find out when I get there.
But man, this brings back memories.{{wi}} My parents were very religious and I used to attend the mass with them every sunday. 
Almost every sunday. My dad was also a big sports fan and he didn’t want to skip any big game.
Mom wasn’t too keen on that and was sometimes going alone. She tried to convince me to go with her, but let's just say some guys chasing a ball are a little more exciting than prayers. 
I never really understood her zeal. You are not going to hell if you skip a few times, right? {{wi}}Well…{{wi}} maybe you do go to hell. I’m not an expert on that matter so I can be wrong.
I wonder why interest in religion went down in the past 10 years. Is it because of those ‘little kids’ scandals or maybe something else? 
It’s not like people stopped believing in higher powers. Being a twiiter witch and astrology is pretty popular nowadays. 
Maybe it’s just because of a bad PR?
Oh.{{wi}} I’m almost there. 
Hmm… {{wi}}from outside it doesn’t look like many people come here. It looks rundown. 
Windows are covered with planks…{{wi}} Did I just waste my time and energy for nothing?!
Oh man… Let’s just get it over with…
Huh? {{wi}}Front door is open. Let’s get inside.
Shit! Doors are big and heavy and it’s hard to push them open! {{wi}}Oh. After a few centimeters of resistance they opened easily.
